RANGE=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
ACT=spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
def measured_targets(res):
    p=dict(zip(spec['proprio_layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    a=[]
    for n in ACT:
        n=n.replace('_A_','_')
        if n.endswith('J0'):
            a.append(p[n[:-1]+'1_pos']+p[n[:-1]+'2_pos'])
        else: a.append(p[n+'_pos'])
    return np.array(a)
def norm(q):return np.clip(2*(q-RANGE[:,0])/(RANGE[:,1]-RANGE[:,0])-1,-1,1)
def move(target,n=10,label='move',balance=True):
    start=r.get_obs(video='none')
    statefile=OUT/'target.npy'
    old=np.load(statefile) if statefile.exists() else measured_targets(start)
    target=np.array([target.get(name,old[i]) for i,name in enumerate(ACT)]) if isinstance(target,dict) else np.array(target)
    actions=[]
    last=start
    for i in range(n):
        frac=(i+1)/n
        q=old+(target-old)*(frac*frac*(3-2*frac))
        if balance:
            p=dict(zip(spec['proprio_layout'],last.meta['proprio']['now']))
            correction=.7*p['imu_gravity_x']+.14*p['imu_gyro_y']
            q[4]+=correction;q[9]+=correction
        a=norm(q)
        with open(OUT/'actions.jsonl','a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(a.tolist())+'\n')
        last=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=['room_camera'],video='none')
        actions.append(a)
        if last.done:break
    np.save(statefile,target)
    last.save(OUT/label)
    print(json.dumps({k:last.meta[k] for k in ['control_steps','done','reason']}))
    p=dict(zip(spec['proprio_layout'],last.meta['proprio']['now']))
    print('IMU',last.meta['proprio']['now'][-6:])
    print('body', {k:round(p[k+'_pos'],3) for k in ACT[:21]})
    return last

def replay():
    recorded=np.array([json.loads(line) for line in (OUT/'actions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()])
    return r.submit('joint_position',recorded,cameras=['room_camera'],video='mp4')
